description: Problem codes the inference API returns (contract 1.0.0). `code` is an open string: clients must handle codes not listed here by HTTP status. `reserved`: whether the request had been reserved (so its Idempotency-Key is spent); `maybe` when it depends on where the failure happened. `retry`: `same_key` the client retries automatically with the same key after Retry-After; `new_key` a caller may resend as a new request with a new key; `fix` the request, credential, or configuration must change first; `none` do not resend automatically.

codes.description: No bearer credential was sent.
The key is unknown, revoked, disabled, or expired.
The key lacks the scope for this endpoint.
Idempotency-Key header missing.
Idempotency-Key is empty or longer than 255 characters.
The request body is over the size limit.
The body was not sent as application/json.
The body is not valid JSON.
The JSON does not match the request schema, for example an unknown field.
Message count or sizes are outside the documented bounds.
A message role is not one the contract lists.
The input is larger than the model's input bound.
temperature is outside 0 to 2.
max_tokens is outside 1 to 4096 or above the model's limit.
Input count or sizes are outside the documented bounds.
The input is larger than the model's input bound.
The model alias is not offered to this caller.
Streams cannot be resumed; Last-Event-ID is refused.
The key was used before with a different request.
The first attempt with this key is still running. Retrying cannot return its answer.
The key is spent: its request already finished. Send a new request with a new key if it is safe to run again.
A budget, or the end user's allowance and credits, cannot cover the request. Retrying does not help until the budget is raised, the user is given more, or the month resets.
A requests-per-minute limit refused the request before anything was reserved. Retry-After gives the wait.
A concurrent-request limit refused the request before anything was reserved. Retry-After gives the wait.
The deployment is failing and was not called. Retry-After gives the wait.
The gateway could not serve inference, for example because its database is unreachable.
The gateway could not check the credential.
The provider refused the request as rate limited; Retry-After passes on its wait when it gave one.
The provider could not be reached or refused the request as unavailable.
The request was rejected as invalid for the provider: by the gateway's own checks for that provider before anything was reserved, or by the provider itself.
The provider did not answer in time. It may have done, and billed, the work.
The provider failed, or a stream ended in a provider error. It may have done, and billed, the work.

The request's bound does not fit: either its input bound exceeds what the route allows (refused before anything was reserved; shrink the request), or the provider used more than the bound allowed (the work was done and billed).
No file with this id belongs to the API key's service account, or its content was purged.
Files are uploaded, and batches read, with purpose `batch` only.
No batch with this id belongs to the API key's service account.
`endpoint` is not `/v1/chat/completions` or `/v1/embeddings`, `completion_window` is not `24h`, or `metadata` is not at most 16 string values.
The input file was refused as a whole before anything was reserved; `errors` lists each refused line by number and code.
The gateway has no file store configured, so it takes no files or batches.
The service account requires the Gateway-End-User header naming the app's user.
The end-user ID (Gateway-End-User or user) is not 1 to 256 bytes of visible UTF-8.
The end user has no plan and the service account has no default plan; the app assigns one first.
The organization's routing policy permits none of the model alias's deployments (provider family or location); an administrator changes the policy or the alias's routes first.
The request's tools, tool_choice, tool calls or tool results break the contract's rules (a bad name or schema, a call without its result, a result for no call); the detail says which.
The request defines tools or carries tool calls or results, and the model alias's route does not take tools, or its provider cannot honour a tool option the request sets; the detail says which.
